children: US stocks edged higher on Tuesday, September 22, with the Nasdaq Composite hitting a fresh all-time intraday high as falling oil prices and continued strength in technology stocks supported sentiment.

On Wednesday, September 23, the US will release its Flash Manufacturing PMI for September at 9:45 AM, with the index expected at 53.5, compared with 53.2 previously. The Flash Services PMI is also scheduled for 9:45 AM, with the reading expected at 55.7, down from 56.8 in the previous release. At 10:05 AM, Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr is scheduled to deliver a speech.

Crude oil prices fell sharply on Tuesday, with Brent dropping below $98 a barrel before recovering slightly, as reports of a possible diplomatic opening between the US and Iran eased some of the geopolitical risk premium in the market.
Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net sellers of ₹3,809.99 crore in equities today, on a provisional basis, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net buyers of ₹4,120.07 crore.
